description: RedCap-owned Feishu notification policy. Only the single reachable lark-cli profile is allowed, and notifications are limited to node reports or human-intervention interrupts.
node_report_rule: Use exactly one node-report notification for a human-visible closeout/status node; do not open a background followup watcher. The message must expose the same status surface as terminal checkpoints: human assistance, blocker status, next-start readiness, panorama, current node, done, previous, and next.
manual_intervention_rule: Use manual-intervention only when RedCap must interrupt because the user needs to make a decision or unblock the task. Internal audit gaps that Cap can continue fixing are not manual intervention.
internal_audit_gap_rule: SessionEnd / Stop audit gaps are ledger-only by default. They may create pending closure and diagnostics, but must not send Feishu unless REDCAP_SESSION_END_NOTIFY_AUDIT_GAP=1 is explicitly used for a true manual-intervention blocker.
routine_success_rule: SessionEnd success notifications are disabled by default; on-complete owns the final node-report notification.
